## Shared style

Category colors are shared across figures. CheckV quality tiers use an ordinal
navy-to-beige palette.

```{r}
#| label: figure-style
#| cache: false
pal_map <- c("Chicken" = "#0072B2", "Duck" = "#D55E00", "Goose" = "#009E73",
  "Quail" = "#E69F00", "Swan" = "#332288", "Crane" = "#88CCEE",
  "Greenshank" = "#44AA99", "Egret" = "#882255", "Pigeon" = "#CC79A7",
  "Bird (unspecified)" = "#9E9E9E")
pal_category <- c(pal_map[c("Chicken", "Duck", "Goose", "Quail", "Pigeon")],
  "Other waterbirds" = "#56B4E9", pal_map["Bird (unspecified)"])
pal_group <- c("Chicken" = "#0072B2", "Duck" = "#D55E00", "Goose" = "#009E73",
  "Other birds" = "#8E6BBF", "Unassigned" = "#C8C8C8")
pal_quality <- c("Complete" = "#1B2A49", "High" = "#3C6E9F", "Medium" = "#6DBCB9",
  "Low" = "#E8DFB0")
pal_lifestyle <- c("Virulent" = "#DE6B66", "Temperate" = "#35BDC8")
pal_function <- c("MISC" = "#C55AC5", "Organic Nitrogen" = "#E39B2D",
  "Carbon utilization" = "#4FA8E8", "Transporters" = "#2E9E3A", "Energy" = "#2A5DA8",
  "Unclassified" = "#9E9E9E")
pal_phylum <- c("Bacillota_A" = "#CC79A7", "Bacillota" = "#0072B2",
  "Bacteroidota" = "#E69F00", "Pseudomonadota" = "#56B4E9", "Actinomycetota" = "#009E73",
  "Bacillota_C" = "#D55E00", "Other phyla" = "#D9C8A9",
  "Multiple predicted phyla" = "#4D4D4D", "Phylum unassigned" = "#C8C8C8")
waterbirds <- c("Swan", "Crane", "Greenshank", "Egret")
map_class <- function(category) {
  dplyr::case_when(is.na(category) ~ "Bird (unspecified)",
    category %in% waterbirds ~ "Other waterbirds", TRUE ~ category)
}
source_group <- function(category, metadata_matched) {
  dplyr::case_when(!metadata_matched ~ "Unassigned",
    category %in% c("Chicken", "Duck", "Goose") ~ category, TRUE ~ "Other birds")
}
theme_pub <- function(base_size = 7, base_family = "Arial") {
  ggplot2::theme_classic(base_size = base_size, base_family = base_family) +
    ggplot2::theme(
      axis.line = ggplot2::element_line(linewidth = 0.3, colour = "black"),
      axis.ticks = ggplot2::element_line(linewidth = 0.3, colour = "black"),
      axis.text = ggplot2::element_text(size = base_size - 0.5, colour = "black"),
      axis.title = ggplot2::element_text(size = base_size),
      legend.title = ggplot2::element_text(size = base_size, face = "bold"),
      legend.text = ggplot2::element_text(size = base_size - 0.5),
      legend.key.size = grid::unit(3, "mm"),
      plot.title = ggplot2::element_text(size = base_size + 1, face = "bold"),
      plot.tag = ggplot2::element_text(size = base_size + 3, face = "bold"),
      strip.background = ggplot2::element_blank(),
      strip.text = ggplot2::element_text(size = base_size, face = "bold"))
}
panel_tag <- function(p, tag) {
  patchwork::wrap_elements(full = p) + ggplot2::labs(tag = tag) +
    ggplot2::theme(plot.tag = ggplot2::element_text(size = 10, face = "bold", family = "Arial"))
}
upset_panel <- function(df, sets, ylab, upright_counts = FALSE) {
  count_text <- if (upright_counts) list(size = 1.9, family = "Arial", vjust = -0.5) else
    list(size = 1.6, family = "Arial", angle = 90, hjust = -0.15, vjust = 0.5)
  ComplexUpset::upset(df, sets, name = NULL, width_ratio = 0.28, min_size = 1,
    sort_sets = FALSE,
    base_annotations = list(ylab = ComplexUpset::intersection_size(
      text = count_text, bar_number_threshold = 1,
      text_mapping = ggplot2::aes(label = scales::comma(exclusive_intersection_size)),
      mapping = ggplot2::aes(fill = "bar"), width = 0.7) +
      ggplot2::scale_fill_manual(values = c(bar = "#00315A"), guide = "none") +
      ggplot2::scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::label_number(scale_cut = scales::cut_short_scale()),
        expand = ggplot2::expansion(c(0, 0.22))) +
      ggplot2::labs(y = ylab) + theme_pub(6.5) +
      ggplot2::theme(axis.title.x = ggplot2::element_blank(), axis.text.x = ggplot2::element_blank(),
        axis.ticks.x = ggplot2::element_blank())) |> stats::setNames(ylab),
    set_sizes = ComplexUpset::upset_set_size(geom = ggplot2::geom_bar(fill = "#DE6B66", width = 0.6)) +
      ggplot2::scale_y_reverse(labels = scales::label_number(scale_cut = scales::cut_short_scale()),
        breaks = scales::breaks_extended(3)) +
      ggplot2::labs(y = "Set size") + theme_pub(6) +
      ggplot2::theme(axis.text.x = ggplot2::element_text(size = 5.5),
        axis.text.y = ggplot2::element_blank(), axis.title.y = ggplot2::element_blank(),
        axis.ticks.y = ggplot2::element_blank(), axis.line.y = ggplot2::element_blank()),
    matrix = ComplexUpset::intersection_matrix(
      geom = ggplot2::geom_point(size = 1.4),
      segment = ggplot2::geom_segment(linewidth = 0.4, colour = "#5B7896"),
      outline_color = list(active = "#5B7896", inactive = "#E3E3E3")) +
      ggplot2::scale_color_manual(values = c("TRUE" = "#5B7896", "FALSE" = "#E3E3E3"),
        guide = "none"),
    stripes = ComplexUpset::upset_stripes(colors = c("#FBEAD5", "white")),
    themes = ComplexUpset::upset_default_themes(text = ggplot2::element_text(size = 6.5,
      family = "Arial")))
}
save_pub_r <- function(plot, filename, width_mm = 183, height_mm = 120, dpi = 600) {
  width_in <- width_mm / 25.4
  height_in <- height_mm / 25.4
  svglite::svglite(paste0(filename, ".svg"), width = width_in, height = height_in,
    system_fonts = list(sans = "Arial"))
  print(plot); grDevices::dev.off()
  grDevices::cairo_pdf(paste0(filename, ".pdf"), width = width_in, height = height_in,
    family = "Arial")
  print(plot); grDevices::dev.off()
  ragg::agg_tiff(paste0(filename, ".tiff"), width = width_in, height = height_in,
    units = "in", res = dpi, compression = "lzw")
  print(plot); grDevices::dev.off()
  ragg::agg_png(paste0(filename, "-preview.png"), width = width_in, height = height_in,
    units = "in", res = 300)
  print(plot); grDevices::dev.off()
  invisible(filename)
}
```

## Inputs

```{r}
#| label: figure-inputs
#| cache: false
path_revision <- path_source("100-reviewer-revision")
path_release <- file.path(path_revision, "release")
df_annotation <- readr::read_tsv(file.path(path_release, "vOTU_annotation.tsv.gz"),
  show_col_types = FALSE, guess_max = 70000)
df_inventory <- readxl::read_excel(file.path(path_revision, "source-metadata-audit.xlsx"),
  sheet = "samples", col_types = "text")
df_locations_raw <- readxl::read_excel(here::here(path_raw, "pc028e3-metadata.xlsx"),
  col_types = "text") |>
  dplyr::distinct(sample_id, geo_loc_name)
df_member_sources <- readr::read_tsv(file.path(path_revision, "figure-source-members.tsv"),
  show_col_types = FALSE, guess_max = 120000)
df_votu_sources <- readr::read_tsv(file.path(path_revision, "figure-source-votus.tsv"),
  show_col_types = FALSE)
stopifnot(nrow(df_annotation) == 61608, nrow(df_inventory) == 2658,
  !anyDuplicated(df_locations_raw$sample_id), nrow(df_member_sources) == 114375,
  nrow(df_votu_sources) == 61608)
df_annotation <- df_annotation |>
  dplyr::mutate(quality = factor(names(pal_quality)[checkv_quality_score],
      levels = names(pal_quality)),
    near_complete = checkv_completeness > 90 & checkv_contamination <= 5)
stopifnot(sum(df_annotation$near_complete) == 12939, !anyNA(df_annotation$quality))
# Exact member IDs determine metadata coverage independently of category resolution.
df_member_groups <- df_member_sources |>
  dplyr::distinct(vOTU_id,
    group = source_group(bird_category, !is.na(metadata_sample_id)))
```

## Figure 1: source-record map

Pie areas scale with the number of source records at each location. Country-level
pies cover the world map, with China combined; the inset resolves the Chinese
provincial-level regions. Location names follow the source metadata after spelling
normalization; city names are assigned to their provinces. Coordinates are
provincial capitals or national reference points.

```{r}
#| label: figure1-map
#| cache: false
location_rules <- c(
  "^China: ?(Hunan|Changsha)$" = "China:Hunan", "^China: ?Beijing$" = "China:Beijing",
  "^China: ?(Jiangsu|JiangSu|JiangShu|Yangzhou|Nantong|Yancheng|Huaian|Nanjing|Suzhou|Taizhou)$" = "China:Jiangsu",
  "^China: ?(Zhejiang|ZheJiang|lanxi|Hangzhou|HangZhou|HaiYan|Jiaxing|ShaoXing)$" = "China:Zhejiang",
  "^China: ?Sichuan$" = "China:Sichuan",
  "^China: ?(Jiangxi|Nanchang|JiAn|Jiangxi Poyanghu)$" = "China:Jiangxi",
  "^China: ?(Guandong|GuangDong|shenzhen|Shenzhen)$" = "China:Guangdong",
  "^China: ?(Shandong|ShanDong)$" = "China:Shandong", "^China: ?Shanxi$" = "China:Shanxi",
  "^China: ?(Henan|HeNan)$" = "China:Henan",
  "^China: ?(Qinghai|Qinghai Gengga Lake)$" = "China:Qinghai", "^China: ?Tibet$" = "China:Tibet",
  "^China: ?Harbin$" = "China:Heilongjiang", "^China: ?FuJian$" = "China:Fujian",
  "^China: ?HeBei$" = "China:Hebei", "^China: ?ShangHai$" = "China:Shanghai",
  "^China: ?InnerMogonia$" = "China:Inner Mongolia", "^China: ?GuiZhou$" = "China:Guizhou",
  "^China: ?(Yichang|Huanggang|Huangshi|Jingzhou)$" = "China:Hubei",
  "^China: ?AnHui$" = "China:Anhui",
  "^Austria.*$" = "Austria", "^United Kingdom.*$" = "United Kingdom", "^Canada.*$" = "Canada",
  "^USA.*$" = "USA")
normalize_location <- function(x) {
  out <- rep(NA_character_, length(x))
  for (pattern in names(location_rules)) {
    hit <- is.na(out) & grepl(pattern, x)
    out[hit] <- location_rules[[pattern]]
  }
  dplyr::coalesce(out, x)
}

df_map_records <- df_inventory |>
  dplyr::left_join(df_locations_raw, by = c(source_sample_identifier = "sample_id"),
    relationship = "many-to-one") |>
  dplyr::mutate(location = normalize_location(geo_loc_name),
    country = ifelse(grepl("^China", location), "China", location),
    map_class = dplyr::coalesce(bird_category, "Bird (unspecified)"))
stopifnot(!anyNA(df_map_records$geo_loc_name),
  all(df_map_records$location %in% df_location_coordinates$location),
  all(df_map_records$country %in% df_location_coordinates$location))
pie_table <- function(df, level) {
  df |>
    dplyr::count(location = .data[[level]], map_class, name = "records") |>
    tidyr::pivot_wider(names_from = map_class, values_from = records, values_fill = 0) |>
    dplyr::mutate(total = rowSums(dplyr::across(dplyr::any_of(names(pal_map))))) |>
    dplyr::left_join(df_location_coordinates, by = "location", relationship = "one-to-one")
}
df_pies_world <- pie_table(df_map_records, "country")
df_pies_china <- pie_table(dplyr::filter(df_map_records, country == "China"), "location") |>
  dplyr::mutate(label = sub("^China:", "", location))
for (column in setdiff(names(pal_map), names(df_pies_world))) df_pies_world[[column]] <- 0
for (column in setdiff(names(pal_map), names(df_pies_china))) df_pies_china[[column]] <- 0
stopifnot(sum(df_pies_world$total) == 2658, sum(df_pies_china$total) ==
  df_pies_world$total[df_pies_world$location == "China"])
radius_world <- function(n) sqrt(n) / 3
# Austria is displaced north-east of the dense European cluster and joined by a leader line.
df_pies_world <- df_pies_world |>
  dplyr::mutate(x_plot = ifelse(location == "Austria", long + 41, long),
    y_plot = ifelse(location == "Austria", lat + 11, lat),
    r = radius_world(total),
    label = dplyr::recode(location, "United Kingdom" = "UK"))
# Fixed label positions keep the dense European labels in two aligned columns.
df_world_labels <- tibble::tribble(
  ~location,        ~x_lab, ~y_lab, ~hjust,
  "United Kingdom",  -14,    58.5,   1,
  "Netherlands",     -14,    54.0,   1,
  "Belgium",         -14,    49.5,   1,
  "France",          -14,    45.0,   1,
  "Spain",           -14,    40.5,   1,
  "Denmark",          28,    61.0,   0,

  "Germany",          28,    51.5,   0,
  "Italy",            28,    43.5,   0,

  "Austria",          55.1,  45.0,   0.5,
  "Canada",         -116.6,  47.5,   0.5,
  "USA",             -73.0,  37.0,   0.5,
  "China",           104.0,  18.5,   0.5) |>
  dplyr::left_join(df_pies_world |> dplyr::select(location, label, x_plot, y_plot, r),
    by = "location", relationship = "one-to-one")
stopifnot(setequal(df_world_labels$location, df_pies_world$location))
class_counts <- df_map_records |> dplyr::count(map_class, name = "records")
stopifnot(identical(class_counts$records[match(names(pal_map), class_counts$map_class)],
  c(2009L, 459L, 71L, 40L, 15L, 11L, 8L, 5L, 3L, 37L)))
class_labels <- stats::setNames(paste0(names(pal_map), " (", scales::comma(
  class_counts$records[match(names(pal_map), class_counts$map_class)]), ")"), names(pal_map))
world <- ggplot2::map_data("world") |> dplyr::filter(region != "Antarctica")
# Union adjacent land polygons so raster antialiasing leaves a continuous fill.
land_polygons <- lapply(split(world, world$group),

land_polygons <- polyclip::polyclip(land_polygons, land_polygons, op = "union")
df_land <- purrr::imap_dfr(land_polygons,
  ~ tibble::tibble(long = .x$x, lat = .x$y, polygon = .y))
coastline <- maps::map("world", interior = FALSE, plot = FALSE)
df_coastline <- tibble::tibble(long = coastline$x, lat = coastline$y,
  group = cumsum(is.na(coastline$x))) |> dplyr::filter(!is.na(long), lat > -60)
size_breaks <- c(20, 200, 1000)
df_size_legend <- tibble::tibble(records = size_breaks, r = radius_world(size_breaks),

    panel.border = ggplot2::element_rect(colour = "grey45", fill = NA, linewidth = 0.4),
    plot.background = ggplot2::element_rect(fill = "white", colour = NA))
figure1 <- cowplot::ggdraw(p_world) +
  cowplot::draw_plot(p_china, x = 0.705, y = 0.0, width = 0.295, height = 0.58)
save_pub_r(figure1, path_target("figure1-source-map"), height_mm = 82)
readr::write_tsv(dplyr::bind_rows(world = df_pies_world |> dplyr::select(-label),
```

## Figure 2: catalog quality, lengths and source categories

Panels a–c describe the full catalog by CheckV quality tier. Panel d compares source
categories; its length column uses only the 12,939 near-complete representatives.
Swan, Crane, Greenshank and Egret form Other waterbirds; a vOTU contributes to every
category among its retained members with an exact metadata match. Matched members
with an unresolved category contribute to Bird (unspecified).

```{r}
#| label: figure2-catalog
#| cache: false
category_levels <- names(pal_category)
df_votu_category <- df_member_sources |>
  dplyr::filter(!is.na(metadata_sample_id)) |>
  dplyr::distinct(vOTU_id, category = map_class(bird_category)) |>
  dplyr::left_join(df_annotation |> dplyr::select(vOTU_id, contig_length, quality,
    near_complete), by = "vOTU_id", relationship = "many-to-one") |>
  dplyr::mutate(category = factor(category, levels = rev(category_levels)))
stopifnot(all(df_votu_category$category %in% category_levels),
  !anyNA(df_votu_category$quality))
length_breaks <- c(0, 5, 10, 15, 20, 30, 40, 50, 100, 200, Inf) * 1000
length_labels <- c("<5", "5–10", "10–15", "15–20", "20–30", "30–40", "40–50",
  "50–100", "100–200", "≥200")
df_length_bins <- df_annotation |>
  dplyr::mutate(bin = cut(contig_length, length_breaks, labels = length_labels,
    right = FALSE)) |>
  dplyr::count(bin, quality, name = "vOTUs")
df_bin_totals <- df_length_bins |> dplyr::group_by(bin) |>
  dplyr::summarise(vOTUs = sum(vOTUs), .groups = "drop")
stopifnot(sum(df_length_bins$vOTUs) == 61608)
p2a <- ggplot2::ggplot(df_length_bins, ggplot2::aes(bin, vOTUs, fill = quality)) +
  ggplot2::geom_col(width = 0.82, colour = "white", linewidth = 0.15) +
  ggplot2::geom_text(data = df_bin_totals, ggplot2::aes(bin, vOTUs,
    label = scales::comma(vOTUs)), inherit.aes = FALSE, vjust = -0.4, size = 1.9,
    family = "Arial") +
  ggplot2::scale_fill_manual(values = pal_quality, guide = "none") +
  ggplot2::scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::comma, expand = ggplot2::expansion(c(0, 0.08))) +
  ggplot2::labs(x = "Contig length (kb)", y = "Number of vOTUs",
    subtitle = paste0("All ", scales::comma(nrow(df_annotation)), " vOTUs; length ",
      scales::comma(min(df_annotation$contig_length)), "–",
      scales::comma(max(df_annotation$contig_length)), " bp")) +
  theme_pub() +
  ggplot2::theme(plot.subtitle = ggplot2::element_text(size = 6.5),
    axis.text.x = ggplot2::element_text(angle = 35, hjust = 1))
df_quality_pie <- df_annotation |> dplyr::count(quality, name = "vOTUs") |>
  dplyr::mutate(percent = 100 * vOTUs / sum(vOTUs),
    y_mid = sum(vOTUs) - (cumsum(vOTUs) - vOTUs / 2),
    outside = percent < 15,
    x_label = ifelse(outside, 1.68, 1.08),
    # Slices run clockwise from 12 o'clock; outside labels extend away from the pie.
    hjust = dplyr::case_when(!outside ~ 0.5, y_mid / sum(vOTUs) > 0.5 ~ 1, TRUE ~ 0),
    text_colour = ifelse(!outside & quality %in% c("Complete", "High"), "white", "black"))
p2b_pie <- ggplot2::ggplot(df_quality_pie, ggplot2::aes(x = 1, y = vOTUs, fill = quality)) +
  ggplot2::geom_col(width = 1, colour = "white", linewidth = 0.3) +
  ggplot2::geom_segment(data = dplyr::filter(df_quality_pie, outside),
    ggplot2::aes(x = 1.52, xend = 1.64, y = y_mid, yend = y_mid), linewidth = 0.25,
    inherit.aes = FALSE) +
  ggplot2::geom_text(ggplot2::aes(x = x_label, y = y_mid, label = sprintf("%.1f%%", percent),
    colour = text_colour, hjust = hjust), size = 2.1, family = "Arial") +
  ggplot2::scale_colour_identity() +
  ggplot2::scale_fill_manual(values = pal_quality, guide = "none") +
  ggplot2::scale_x_continuous(limits = c(0.5, 1.7)) +
  ggplot2::coord_polar(theta = "y", clip = "off") +

      label = scales::comma(.data[[column]])), hjust = ifelse(inside, 1.12, -0.15),
```

## Figure 4: class and family annotations

In the pie-of-pie panels, the large pie shows all entries
and the small pie expands the minor slice. Panel c traces Class → Order → Family
for the 2,887 vOTUs with a named family. The 15 largest families retain their names;
smaller families retain their names in orders containing one or two named families.
Other families form an order-specific Other known families node. Placeholder and
missing labels count as unassigned.

```{r}
#| label: figure4-taxonomy
#| cache: false
pal_class <- c("Caudoviricetes" = "#8AC6D1", "Malgrandaviricetes" = "#FFB6B9",
  "Maveriviricetes" = "#007FB9", "Arfiviricetes" = "#E4694C", "Tectiliviricetes" = "#FF7F00",
  "Faserviricetes" = "#008000", "Megaviricetes" = "#BF3922", "Repensiviricetes" = "#C0D036",
  "Quintoviricetes" = "#9370DB", "Revtraviricetes" = "#0000FF", "Unassigned" = "#999999")
pal_family <- c("Microviridae" = "#FFB6B9", "Peduoviridae" = "#E4694C",
  "Drexlerviridae" = "#FF7F00", "Salasmaviridae" = "#9370DB", "Autographiviridae" = "#FFB756",
  "Herelleviridae" = "#CE9FCA", "Rountreeviridae" = "#C0D036", "Suoliviridae" = "#007577",
  "Schitoviridae" = "#0000FF", "Other named families" = "#008000", "Unassigned" = "#8AC6D1")
rank_changed <- c("Microviridae", "Autographiviridae", "Lavidaviridae")
df_tax <- df_annotation |>
  dplyr::mutate(class = dplyr::if_else(is.na(class) | class == "unassigned", "Unassigned", class),
    family = dplyr::if_else(is.na(family) | family == "unassigned", "Unassigned", family))
df_class_counts <- df_tax |> dplyr::count(class, name = "vOTUs") |> dplyr::arrange(dplyr::desc(vOTUs))
df_family_counts <- df_tax |> dplyr::count(family, class, name = "vOTUs")
stopifnot(sum(df_class_counts$vOTUs) == 61608, all(df_class_counts$class %in% names(pal_class)),
  sum(df_family_counts$vOTUs[df_family_counts$family == "Unassigned"]) == 58721,
  !anyDuplicated(df_family_counts$family[df_family_counts$family != "Unassigned"]))
# Angles follow ggforce: 0 at 12 o'clock, clockwise. The minor slice faces the zoom pie.
pie_of_pie <- function(major, minor, pal, legend_title, minor_title) {
  share <- sum(minor$vOTUs) / (sum(minor$vOTUs) + major$vOTUs)
  width <- 2 * pi * share
  big <- tibble::tibble(slice = c(major$label, "minor"),
    start = c(1.5 * pi + width / 2, 1.5 * pi - width / 2),
    end = c(1.5 * pi - width / 2 + 2 * pi, 1.5 * pi + width / 2),
    fill = c(major$label, "minor"), x0 = 0, y0 = 0, r = 1)
  minor <- minor |> dplyr::mutate(end = 2 * pi * cumsum(vOTUs) / sum(vOTUs),
    start = dplyr::lag(end, default = 0), x0 = -2.45, y0 = 0, r = 0.78, fill = label)
  links <- tibble::tibble(x = sin(c(1.5 * pi + width / 2, 1.5 * pi - width / 2)),
    y = cos(c(1.5 * pi + width / 2, 1.5 * pi - width / 2)), xend = -2.45, yend = c(0.78, -0.78))
  fills <- c(pal, minor = unname(pal[[minor_title]]))
  legend_levels <- c(major$label, minor$label)
  legend_labels <- paste(scales::comma(c(major$vOTUs, minor$vOTUs)), legend_levels)
  ggplot2::ggplot() +
    ggforce::geom_arc_bar(data = big, ggplot2::aes(x0 = x0, y0 = y0, r0 = 0, r = r,
      start = start, end = end, fill = fill), colour = "white", linewidth = 0.2) +
    ggforce::geom_arc_bar(data = minor, ggplot2::aes(x0 = x0, y0 = y0, r0 = 0, r = r,
      start = start, end = end, fill = fill), colour = "white", linewidth = 0.15) +
    ggplot2::geom_segment(data = links, ggplot2::aes(x = x, y = y, xend = xend, yend = yend),
      linetype = "dotted", linewidth = 0.3) +
    ggplot2::scale_fill_manual(values = fills, breaks = legend_levels, labels = legend_labels,
      name = legend_title) +
    ggplot2::coord_equal() + ggplot2::theme_void(base_size = 6.5, base_family = "Arial") +
    ggplot2::theme(legend.key.size = grid::unit(2.6, "mm"),
      legend.title = ggplot2::element_text(face = "bold", size = 6.5),
      legend.text = ggplot2::element_text(size = 5.8))
}
minor_classes <- df_class_counts |> dplyr::filter(class != "Caudoviricetes") |>
  dplyr::transmute(label = class, vOTUs)
pal_class_pie <- c(pal_class, "Other classes" = "#FFB6B9")
p4a <- pie_of_pie(major = tibble::tibble(label = "Caudoviricetes",
    vOTUs = df_class_counts$vOTUs[df_class_counts$class == "Caudoviricetes"]),
  minor = minor_classes, pal = pal_class_pie, legend_title = "Class",
  minor_title = "Malgrandaviricetes")
df_named <- df_family_counts |> dplyr::filter(family != "Unassigned") |>
  dplyr::arrange(dplyr::desc(vOTUs))
top_families <- head(df_named$family, 9)
minor_families <- df_named |>
  dplyr::mutate(label = ifelse(family %in% top_families, family, "Other named families")) |>
  dplyr::group_by(label) |> dplyr::summarise(vOTUs = sum(vOTUs), .groups = "drop") |>
  dplyr::arrange(label == "Other named families", dplyr::desc(vOTUs))
p4b <- pie_of_pie(major = tibble::tibble(label = "Unassigned",
    vOTUs = sum(df_family_counts$vOTUs[df_family_counts$family == "Unassigned"])),
  minor = minor_families, pal = pal_family, legend_title = "Family",
  minor_title = "Microviridae")
# Family aggregation and node allocation use exact rank keys, O(n log n).
# Every flow retains its count; spacing separates the smallest named nodes.
top_sankey_families <- head(df_named$family, 15)
df_sankey <- df_tax |>
  dplyr::filter(family != "Unassigned") |>
  dplyr::mutate(order = dplyr::if_else(is.na(order) | order == "unassigned",
    "Order unassigned", order)) |>
  dplyr::group_by(class, order) |>
  dplyr::mutate(named_families_in_order = dplyr::n_distinct(family),
    family = ifelse(family %in% top_sankey_families | named_families_in_order <= 2,
      family, "Other known families")) |>
  dplyr::ungroup() |>
  dplyr::count(class, order, family, name = "vOTUs") |>
  dplyr::mutate(class_order = match(class, c("Malgrandaviricetes", "Caudoviricetes",
      setdiff(names(pal_class), c("Malgrandaviricetes", "Caudoviricetes")))),
    order_unassigned = order == "Order unassigned") |>
  dplyr::arrange(class_order, dplyr::desc(order_unassigned), order,
    family == "Other known families", dplyr::desc(vOTUs), family) |>
  dplyr::select(class, order, family, vOTUs) |>
  dplyr::mutate(alluvium = dplyr::row_number(),
    slice = ifelse(family %in% top_families, family, "Other named families"))
stopifnot(sum(df_sankey$vOTUs) == 2887L,
  all(top_sankey_families %in% df_sankey$family))
df_sankey_lodes <- dplyr::bind_rows(
  df_sankey |> dplyr::transmute(alluvium, vOTUs, slice, x = 1,
    node = class, label = class),
  df_sankey |> dplyr::transmute(alluvium, vOTUs, slice, x = 2,
    node = paste(class, order, sep = "::"), label = order),
  df_sankey |> dplyr::transmute(alluvium, vOTUs, slice, x = 3,
    node = paste(class, order, family, sep = "::"),
    label = ifelse(family %in% rank_changed, paste0(family, "†"), family)))
df_sankey_nodes <- df_sankey_lodes |>
  dplyr::group_by(x, node) |>
  dplyr::summarise(label = dplyr::first(label), vOTUs = sum(vOTUs),
    node_order = min(alluvium), slice = dplyr::first(slice), .groups = "drop") |>
  dplyr::arrange(x, node_order)
sankey_padding <- 85 * (sum(df_sankey_nodes$x == 3) - 1)
sankey_height <- 2887 + sankey_padding
df_sankey_nodes <- df_sankey_nodes |>
  dplyr::group_by(x) |>
  dplyr::mutate(ymin = sankey_height - cumsum(vOTUs) -
      (dplyr::row_number() - 1) * sankey_padding / (dplyr::n() - 1),
    ymax = ymin + vOTUs, y = (ymin + ymax) / 2,
    label = paste0(label, " (", scales::comma(vOTUs), ")"),
    fill = ifelse(x == 3, unname(pal_family[slice]), "#BFC7CB")) |>
  dplyr::ungroup()
df_sankey_lodes <- df_sankey_lodes |>
  dplyr::left_join(df_sankey_nodes |> dplyr::select(x, node, node_top = ymax),
    by = c("x", "node"), relationship = "many-to-one") |>
  dplyr::group_by(x, node) |>
  dplyr::arrange(alluvium, .by_group = TRUE) |>
  dplyr::mutate(ymin = node_top - cumsum(vOTUs), ymax = ymin + vOTUs,
    y = (ymin + ymax) / 2) |>
  dplyr::ungroup()
stopifnot(all(abs(df_sankey_lodes$ymax - df_sankey_lodes$ymin -
  df_sankey_lodes$vOTUs) < 1e-8))
p4c <- ggplot2::ggplot(df_sankey_lodes,
    ggplot2::aes(x = x, y = y, ymin = ymin, ymax = ymax, alluvium = alluvium)) +
  ggalluvial::geom_flow(ggplot2::aes(fill = slice), stat = "identity", width = 0.045,
    alpha = 0.65, colour = "transparent", curve_type = "cubic") +
  ggplot2::scale_fill_manual(values = pal_family, guide = "none") +
  ggplot2::geom_rect(data = df_sankey_nodes,
    ggplot2::aes(xmin = x - 0.0225, xmax = x + 0.0225, ymin = ymin, ymax = ymax),
    fill = df_sankey_nodes$fill, colour = "grey45", linewidth = 0.15,
    inherit.aes = FALSE) +
  ggplot2::geom_text(data = dplyr::filter(df_sankey_nodes, x == 1),
    ggplot2::aes(x = x - 0.065, y = y, label = label), hjust = 1,
    size = 1.9, family = "Arial", inherit.aes = FALSE) +
  ggplot2::geom_text(data = dplyr::filter(df_sankey_nodes, x == 3),
    ggplot2::aes(x = x + 0.065, y = y, label = label), hjust = 0,
    size = 1.9, family = "Arial", inherit.aes = FALSE) +
  ggplot2::geom_label(data = dplyr::filter(df_sankey_nodes, x == 2),
    ggplot2::aes(x = x, y = y, label = label), fill = "white", linewidth = 0,
    label.padding = grid::unit(1.4, "pt"), label.r = grid::unit(0, "pt"),
    size = 1.9, family = "Arial", inherit.aes = FALSE) +
  ggplot2::scale_x_continuous(breaks = 1:3, labels = c("Class", "Order", "Family"),
    limits = c(-0.20, 4.50), position = "top", expand = c(0, 0)) +
  ggplot2::scale_y_continuous(expand = ggplot2::expansion(c(0.015, 0.015))) +
  ggplot2::labs(title = "2,887 entries with a named family",
    caption = "† Promoted to a higher rank under a different name in ICTV MSL41") +
  ggplot2::theme_void(base_family = "Arial") +
  ggplot2::theme(axis.text.x = ggplot2::element_text(size = 6.5, face = "bold"),
    plot.title = ggplot2::element_text(size = 6.8, hjust = 0.5),
    plot.caption = ggplot2::element_text(size = 5.6, hjust = 0),
    plot.margin = ggplot2::margin(5.5, 0, 5.5, 0))
figure4 <- (patchwork::wrap_elements(full = p4a) / patchwork::wrap_elements(full = p4b) |
    patchwork::wrap_elements(full = p4c)) +
  patchwork::plot_layout(widths = c(102, 130)) +
  patchwork::plot_annotation(tag_levels = "a") &
  ggplot2::theme(plot.tag = ggplot2::element_text(size = 10, face = "bold", family = "Arial"))
save_pub_r(figure4, path_target("figure4-taxonomy"), width_mm = 232, height_mm = 140)
readr::write_tsv(dplyr::bind_rows(
  df_class_counts |> dplyr::rename(taxon = class) |>
    dplyr::mutate(rank = "class", panel = "class"),
  df_family_counts |> dplyr::rename(taxon = family) |> dplyr::select(-class) |>
    dplyr::mutate(rank = "family", panel = "family"),
  df_sankey |> dplyr::select(class, order, family, vOTUs) |>
    dplyr::mutate(panel = "sankey_class_order_family")) |>
  dplyr::select(rank, taxon, vOTUs, panel, class, order, family),
  path_target("figure4-counts.tsv"))
```

## Figure 5: host predictions for near-complete representatives

All panels use the 12,939 representatives with completeness >90% and contamination
≤5%. Host predictions are iPHoP assignments with confidence ≥90. GC content comes
from the step 55 table, which step 100 checked against the released sequences.

```{r}
#| label: figure5-hosts
#| cache: false
con_hosts <- DBI::dbConnect(RSQLite::SQLite(), here::here("pc028e3.sqlite"),
  flags = RSQLite::SQLITE_RO)
df_hosts <- DBI::dbReadTable(con_hosts, "host_filtered") |>
  tidyr::separate(Host.taxonomy, into = c("Domain", "Phylum", "Class", "Order", "Family",
    "Genus", "Species"), sep = ";", fill = "right") |>
  dplyr::mutate(dplyr::across(Domain:Species,
    ~ dplyr::na_if(stringr::str_remove(.x, "^[a-z]__"), "")))
DBI::dbDisconnect(con_hosts)
df_gc <- readr::read_tsv(here::here(path_raw, "d55-fig5", "gc.tsv"),
  col_names = c("contig_repid", "gc_percent"), show_col_types = FALSE)
df_nc <- df_annotation |> dplyr::filter(near_complete) |>
  dplyr::select(vOTU_id, contig_repid, contig_length, lifestyle, class) |>
  dplyr::left_join(df_gc, by = "contig_repid", relationship = "one-to-one")
stopifnot(nrow(df_nc) == 12939, !anyNA(df_nc$gc_percent))
df_host_pairs <- df_nc |>
  dplyr::inner_join(df_hosts |> dplyr::distinct(contig_id, Phylum, Genus),
    by = c(contig_repid = "contig_id"), relationship = "one-to-many")
df_phylum_pairs <- df_host_pairs |> dplyr::filter(!is.na(Phylum)) |> dplyr::distinct(vOTU_id, Phylum)
df_genus_pairs <- df_host_pairs |> dplyr::filter(!is.na(Genus)) |> dplyr::distinct(vOTU_id, Genus)
df_genus_n <- df_genus_pairs |> dplyr::count(vOTU_id, name = "predicted_genera")
stopifnot(dplyr::n_distinct(df_host_pairs$vOTU_id) == 8853, nrow(df_genus_n) == 8852,
  dplyr::n_distinct(df_phylum_pairs$Phylum) == 29)
shown_phyla <- setdiff(names(pal_phylum), c("Other phyla", "Multiple predicted phyla",
  "Phylum unassigned"))
df_nc <- df_nc |>
  dplyr::left_join(df_phylum_pairs |> dplyr::group_by(vOTU_id) |>
    dplyr::summarise(phylum_label = if (dplyr::n() == 1) Phylum[[1]] else
      "Multiple predicted phyla", .groups = "drop"), by = "vOTU_id") |>
  dplyr::mutate(phylum_label = dplyr::case_when(is.na(phylum_label) ~ "Phylum unassigned",
      phylum_label %in% c(shown_phyla, "Multiple predicted phyla") ~ phylum_label,
      TRUE ~ "Other phyla"),
    phylum_label = factor(phylum_label, levels = names(pal_phylum)))
p5a_main <- ggplot2::ggplot(dplyr::arrange(df_nc, phylum_label == "Phylum unassigned") |>
    dplyr::arrange(dplyr::desc(phylum_label == "Phylum unassigned")),
    ggplot2::aes(contig_length / 1000, gc_percent, colour = phylum_label)) +
  ggplot2::geom_point(size = 0.35, alpha = 0.6, stroke = 0) +
  ggplot2::scale_x_log10(breaks = c(3, 10, 30, 100, 300)) +
  ggplot2::scale_colour_manual(values = pal_phylum, name = "Predicted host phylum",
    drop = FALSE) +
  ggplot2::guides(colour = ggplot2::guide_legend(override.aes = list(size = 1.8, alpha = 1),
    ncol = 1)) +
  ggplot2::labs(x = "Contig length (kb; log10 scale)", y = "GC content (%)") +
  theme_pub(6.5) + ggplot2::theme(legend.position = "right")
p5a_top <- ggplot2::ggplot(df_nc, ggplot2::aes(contig_length / 1000, fill = phylum_label)) +
  ggplot2::geom_histogram(bins = 60, linewidth = 0) +
  ggplot2::scale_x_log10(breaks = c(3, 10, 30, 100, 300)) +
  ggplot2::scale_fill_manual(values = pal_phylum, guide = "none") +
  ggplot2::scale_y_continuous(expand = c(0, 0)) +
  ggplot2::theme_void()
p5a_right <- ggplot2::ggplot(df_nc, ggplot2::aes(y = gc_percent, fill = phylum_label)) +
  ggplot2::geom_histogram(bins = 45, linewidth = 0) +
  ggplot2::scale_fill_manual(values = pal_phylum, guide = "none") +
  ggplot2::scale_x_continuous(expand = c(0, 0)) +
  ggplot2::theme_void()
p5a <- p5a_top + patchwork::plot_spacer() + p5a_main + p5a_right +
  patchwork::plot_layout(ncol = 2, widths = c(4, 0.7), heights = c(0.7, 4), guides = "collect")
df_phylum_bars <- df_phylum_pairs |>
  dplyr::count(Phylum, name = "vOTUs") |>
  dplyr::mutate(Phylum = ifelse(vOTUs < 100, "Other phyla", Phylum)) |>
  dplyr::group_by(Phylum) |> dplyr::summarise(vOTUs = sum(vOTUs), .groups = "drop") |>
  dplyr::bind_rows(tibble::tibble(Phylum = "Host unknown",
    vOTUs = sum(df_nc$phylum_label == "Phylum unassigned"))) |>
  dplyr::mutate(Phylum = factor(Phylum, levels = rev(c("Host unknown",
    setdiff(Phylum[order(-vOTUs)], c("Host unknown", "Other phyla")), "Other phyla"))))
pal_phylum_bars <- c(pal_phylum, "Host unknown" = "#C8C8C8",
  "Desulfobacterota" = "#9AA5B1", "Cyanobacteriota" = "#9AA5B1")
p5b <- ggplot2::ggplot(df_phylum_bars, ggplot2::aes(vOTUs, Phylum, fill = Phylum)) +
  ggplot2::geom_col(width = 0.72) +
  ggplot2::geom_text(ggplot2::aes(label = scales::comma(vOTUs)), hjust = -0.15, size = 1.8,
    family = "Arial") +
  ggplot2::scale_fill_manual(values = pal_phylum_bars, guide = "none") +
  ggplot2::scale_x_continuous(labels = scales::label_number(scale_cut = scales::cut_short_scale()),
    expand = ggplot2::expansion(c(0, 0.3))) +
  ggplot2::labs(x = "vOTUs per predicted phylum", y = NULL) + theme_pub(6.5) +
  ggplot2::theme(plot.margin = ggplot2::margin(12, 4, 4, 4))
df_genus_hist <- df_genus_n |> dplyr::count(predicted_genera, name = "vOTUs") |>
  dplyr::mutate(type = ifelse(predicted_genera == 1, "Single genus", "Multiple genera"))
pal_multiplicity <- c("Single genus" = "#5A6FC0", "Multiple genera" = "#9BC46B")
p5c <- ggplot2::ggplot(df_genus_hist, ggplot2::aes(factor(predicted_genera), vOTUs, fill = type)) +
  ggplot2::geom_col(width = 0.75) +
  ggplot2::geom_text(ggplot2::aes(label = scales::comma(vOTUs)), vjust = -0.35, size = 1.7,
    family = "Arial") +
  ggplot2::scale_fill_manual(values = pal_multiplicity, name = NULL) +
  ggplot2::scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::comma, expand = ggplot2::expansion(c(0, 0.12))) +
  ggplot2::scale_x_discrete(expand = ggplot2::expansion(add = c(0.9, 0.4))) +
  ggplot2::labs(x = "Predicted host genera per vOTU", y = "Number of vOTUs") +
  theme_pub(6.5) + ggplot2::theme(legend.position = c(0.7, 0.75))
genus_phylum <- df_host_pairs |> dplyr::filter(!is.na(Genus)) |>
  dplyr::distinct(Genus, Phylum) |> dplyr::group_by(Genus) |>
  dplyr::summarise(Phylum = Phylum[[1]], .groups = "drop")
df_genus_votus <- df_genus_pairs |>
  dplyr::left_join(df_nc |> dplyr::select(vOTU_id, contig_length, lifestyle, class),
    by = "vOTU_id") |>
  dplyr::left_join(df_genus_n, by = "vOTU_id")
top_genera <- df_genus_votus |> dplyr::count(Genus, name = "vOTUs") |>
  dplyr::filter(vOTUs >= 60) |> dplyr::arrange(dplyr::desc(vOTUs))
stopifnot(nrow(top_genera) == 40)
df_top_genus <- df_genus_votus |> dplyr::filter(Genus %in% top_genera$Genus) |>
  dplyr::left_join(genus_phylum, by = "Genus") |>
  dplyr::mutate(Genus = factor(Genus, levels = rev(top_genera$Genus)),
    phylum_fill = ifelse(Phylum %in% shown_phyla, Phylum, "Other phyla"))
genus_y <- function(p, show = FALSE) {
  p + theme_pub(6) + ggplot2::theme(axis.text.y = if (show)
      ggplot2::element_text(size = 5.4, face = "italic") else ggplot2::element_blank(),
    axis.ticks.y = if (show) ggplot2::element_line(linewidth = 0.3) else ggplot2::element_blank(),
    axis.line.y = if (show) ggplot2::element_line(linewidth = 0.3) else ggplot2::element_blank(),
    axis.text.x = ggplot2::element_text(size = 5.3))
}
p5d_count <- genus_y(ggplot2::ggplot(df_top_genus |> dplyr::count(Genus, phylum_fill, name = "vOTUs"),
    ggplot2::aes(vOTUs, Genus, fill = phylum_fill)) +
  ggplot2::geom_col(width = 0.75) +
  ggplot2::scale_fill_manual(values = pal_phylum, guide = "none") +
  ggplot2::scale_x_continuous(expand = ggplot2::expansion(c(0, 0.05)), breaks = c(0, 300, 600)) +
  ggplot2::labs(x = "vOTUs", y = NULL), show = TRUE)
p5d_length <- genus_y(ggplot2::ggplot(df_top_genus, ggplot2::aes(contig_length / 1000, Genus,
    fill = phylum_fill)) +
  ggplot2::geom_boxplot(outlier.size = 0.2, outlier.stroke = 0, width = 0.65, linewidth = 0.2) +
  ggplot2::scale_fill_manual(values = pal_phylum, guide = "none") +
  ggplot2::scale_x_log10(breaks = c(10, 100)) +
  ggplot2::labs(x = "Length (kb)", y = NULL))
stack_share <- function(df, column, pal, title) {
  genus_y(ggplot2::ggplot(df |> dplyr::count(Genus, value = .data[[column]], name = "n"),
      ggplot2::aes(n, Genus, fill = value)) +
    ggplot2::geom_col(position = ggplot2::position_fill(reverse = TRUE), width = 0.75) +
    ggplot2::scale_x_continuous(labels = c("0", "50", "100"), breaks = c(0, 0.5, 1),
      expand = c(0, 0)) +
    ggplot2::scale_fill_manual(values = pal, name = title) +
    ggplot2::labs(x = paste0(title, "\n(%)"), y = NULL))
}
df_top_genus <- df_top_genus |>
  dplyr::mutate(class_label = dplyr::case_when(class == "Caudoviricetes" ~ "Caudoviricetes",
      is.na(class) | class == "unassigned" ~ "Unassigned", TRUE ~ "Other classes"),
    lifestyle_label = factor(stringr::str_to_sentence(lifestyle), levels = names(pal_lifestyle)),
    multiplicity = factor(ifelse(predicted_genera == 1, "Single genus", "Multiple genera"),
      levels = names(pal_multiplicity)))
p5d_class <- stack_share(df_top_genus, "class_label", c("Caudoviricetes" = "#8AC6D1",
  "Other classes" = "#FFB6B9", "Unassigned" = "#999999"), "Class")
p5d_life <- stack_share(df_top_genus, "lifestyle_label", pal_lifestyle, "Lifestyle")
p5d_mult <- stack_share(df_top_genus, "multiplicity", pal_multiplicity, "Genera")
p5d <- (p5d_count | p5d_length | p5d_class | p5d_life | p5d_mult) +

  ggplot2::theme(legend.position = "bottom", legend.direction = "vertical",
    legend.title = ggplot2::element_text(size = 6, face = "bold"),
    legend.text = ggplot2::element_text(size = 5.5),
    plot.margin = ggplot2::margin(2, 6, 2, 2))
left_col <- panel_tag(p5a, "a") / (panel_tag(p5b, "b") | panel_tag(p5c, "c")) +
  patchwork::plot_layout(heights = c(1.35, 1))
figure5 <- (left_col | panel_tag(p5d, "d")) + patchwork::plot_layout(widths = c(1.15, 1))
save_pub_r(figure5, path_target("figure5-host-summary"), height_mm = 175)
readr::write_tsv(dplyr::bind_rows(
  phylum = df_phylum_bars |> dplyr::transmute(item = as.character(Phylum), vOTUs),

  top_genera = top_genera |> dplyr::transmute(item = Genus, vOTUs), .id = "panel"),
  path_target("figure5-counts.tsv"))
```

## Figure 7: DRAM-v functional annotations

Counts use DRAM-v records of the near-complete and other catalog representatives, as
in Table S9. Panel a counts protein–category assignments; panels b and c count
distinct proteins. Source groups in panel c count vOTU–group pairs of the vOTUs that
carry each module annotation.

```{r}
#| label: figure7-functions
#| cache: false
con_function <- DBI::dbConnect(RSQLite::SQLite(), here::here("pc028e3.sqlite"),
  flags = RSQLite::SQLITE_RO)
df_dramv <- DBI::dbReadTable(con_function, "amg_dramv_filtered")
DBI::dbDisconnect(con_function)
df_function <- df_dramv |>
  dplyr::select(contig_id, protein_id, dbid, module, sheet, header) |>
  dplyr::distinct() |>
  dplyr::inner_join(df_annotation |> dplyr::select(contig_repid, vOTU_id),
    by = c(contig_id = "contig_repid"), relationship = "many-to-one") |>
  dplyr::mutate(dplyr::across(c(module, sheet, header), ~ dplyr::coalesce(trimws(.x), "")),
    sheet = dplyr::case_when(
      sheet %in% c("carbon utilization", "carbon utilization (Woodcroft)") ~ "Carbon utilization",
      sheet == "" ~ "Unclassified", TRUE ~ sheet),
    header = ifelse(header == "", "Unclassified", header),
    module = ifelse(module == "", "Unclassified", module))
capitalize_first <- function(x) paste0(toupper(substr(x, 1, 1)), substring(x, 2))
# KEGG M00053 is stored without its module name in the archived DRAM-v output.
df_function <- df_function |>
  dplyr::mutate(module = dplyr::recode(module, "M00053" = paste("Deoxyribonucleotide",
      "biosynthesis, ADP/GDP/CDP/UDP => dATP/dGTP/dCTP/dUTP (M00053)")),
    module = capitalize_first(module), header = capitalize_first(header))
stopifnot(dplyr::n_distinct(df_function$protein_id) == 10095,
  dplyr::n_distinct(df_function$vOTU_id) == 7257, all(df_function$sheet %in% names(pal_function)))
df_broad <- df_function |> dplyr::group_by(sheet) |>
  dplyr::summarise(proteins = dplyr::n_distinct(protein_id), .groups = "drop") |>
  dplyr::mutate(percent = 100 * proteins / sum(proteins)) |>
  dplyr::arrange(dplyr::desc(proteins)) |>
  dplyr::mutate(sheet = factor(sheet, levels = sheet),
    y_mid = sum(proteins) - (cumsum(proteins) - proteins / 2),
    x_label = 1.05)
stopifnot(sum(df_broad$proteins) == 10691)
p7a <- ggplot2::ggplot(df_broad, ggplot2::aes(x = 1, y = proteins, fill = sheet)) +
  ggplot2::geom_col(width = 1, colour = "white", linewidth = 0.3) +
  ggplot2::geom_text(data = dplyr::filter(df_broad, percent >= 5),
    ggplot2::aes(x = x_label, y = y_mid, label = sprintf("%.1f%%", percent)),
    size = 2.1, family = "Arial") +
  ggplot2::scale_fill_manual(values = pal_function, name = "Broad category",
    labels = stats::setNames(sprintf("%s (%.1f%%)", df_broad$sheet, df_broad$percent),

  ggplot2::scale_x_continuous(limits = c(0.5, 1.6)) +
  ggplot2::coord_polar(theta = "y") +
  ggplot2::labs(title = paste0(scales::comma(sum(df_broad$proteins)),
    " protein–category assignments")) +
  ggplot2::theme_void(base_size = 6.5, base_family = "Arial") +
  ggplot2::theme(plot.title = ggplot2::element_text(size = 6.8, hjust = 0.5),
    legend.key.size = grid::unit(2.6, "mm"),
    legend.title = ggplot2::element_text(face = "bold", size = 6.5))
df_sub <- df_function |> dplyr::group_by(header) |>
  dplyr::summarise(proteins = dplyr::n_distinct(protein_id),
    sheet = names(sort(table(sheet), decreasing = TRUE))[[1]], .groups = "drop") |>
  dplyr::arrange(proteins) |>
  dplyr::mutate(header = factor(header, levels = header))
p7b <- ggplot2::ggplot(df_sub, ggplot2::aes(proteins, header, fill = sheet)) +
  ggplot2::geom_col(width = 0.72) +
  ggplot2::geom_text(ggplot2::aes(label = scales::comma(proteins)), hjust = -0.15, size = 1.8,
    family = "Arial") +
  ggplot2::scale_fill_manual(values = pal_function, guide = "none") +
  ggplot2::scale_x_continuous(labels = scales::label_number(scale_cut = scales::cut_short_scale()),
    expand = ggplot2::expansion(c(0, 0.18))) +
  ggplot2::labs(x = "Distinct proteins", y = NULL, title = "Annotation subcategories") +
  theme_pub(6.5) + ggplot2::theme(plot.title = ggplot2::element_text(size = 6.8))
df_modules <- df_function |> dplyr::filter(module != "Unclassified") |>
  dplyr::group_by(module) |>
  dplyr::summarise(proteins = dplyr::n_distinct(protein_id),
    sheet = names(sort(table(sheet), decreasing = TRUE))[[1]], .groups = "drop") |>
  dplyr::slice_max(proteins, n = 25, with_ties = FALSE) |>
  dplyr::mutate(label = stringr::str_wrap(module, 52),
    label = factor(label, levels = rev(label)))
df_module_groups <- df_function |>
  dplyr::filter(module %in% df_modules$module) |>
  dplyr::distinct(module, vOTU_id) |>
  dplyr::left_join(df_member_groups, by = "vOTU_id",
    relationship = "many-to-many") |>
  dplyr::mutate(group = factor(dplyr::coalesce(group, "Unassigned"), levels = names(pal_group))) |>
  dplyr::count(module, group, name = "pairs") |>
  dplyr::left_join(df_modules |> dplyr::select(module, label), by = "module")
p7c_lolli <- ggplot2::ggplot(df_modules, ggplot2::aes(proteins, label, colour = sheet)) +
  ggplot2::geom_segment(ggplot2::aes(x = 1, xend = proteins, yend = label), linewidth = 0.6) +
  ggplot2::geom_point(size = 1.6) +
  ggplot2::geom_text(ggplot2::aes(label = scales::comma(proteins)), hjust = -0.35, size = 1.75,
    family = "Arial", colour = "black") +
  ggplot2::scale_colour_manual(values = pal_function, guide = "none") +
  ggplot2::scale_x_log10(labels = scales::comma, expand = ggplot2::expansion(c(0, 0.12))) +
  ggplot2::labs(x = "Distinct proteins (log10 scale)", y = NULL,
    title = "Most frequent module annotations") +
  theme_pub(6.5) + ggplot2::theme(axis.text.y = ggplot2::element_text(size = 5.6),
    plot.title = ggplot2::element_text(size = 6.8))
p7c_group <- ggplot2::ggplot(df_module_groups, ggplot2::aes(pairs, label, fill = group)) +
  ggplot2::geom_col(position = ggplot2::position_fill(reverse = TRUE), width = 0.72) +
  ggplot2::scale_x_continuous(labels = c("0", "50", "100"), breaks = c(0, 0.5, 1),
    expand = c(0, 0)) +
  ggplot2::scale_fill_manual(values = pal_group, name = "Source group") +
  ggplot2::labs(x = "Source groups (%)", y = NULL) +
  theme_pub(6.5) + ggplot2::theme(axis.text.y = ggplot2::element_blank(),
    axis.ticks.y = ggplot2::element_blank(), axis.line.y = ggplot2::element_blank())
p7c <- (p7c_lolli | p7c_group) + patchwork::plot_layout(widths = c(3, 1))
figure7 <- ((panel_tag(p7a, "a") | panel_tag(p7b, "b")) + patchwork::plot_layout(widths = c(1, 1.15))) /
  panel_tag(p7c, "c") + patchwork::plot_layout(heights = c(0.85, 1.25))
save_pub_r(figure7, path_target("figure7-annotation-summary"), height_mm = 185)
readr::write_tsv(dplyr::bind_rows(
  broad = df_broad |> dplyr::transmute(item = as.character(sheet), proteins),
  subcategory = df_sub |> dplyr::transmute(item = as.character(header), proteins),
  module = df_modules |> dplyr::transmute(item = module, proteins),
  module_source_groups = df_module_groups |>
    dplyr::transmute(item = module, group = as.character(group), pairs), .id = "level"),
  path_target("figure7-counts.tsv"))
```

## Figure 6: archived gene-content dendrogram and network modules

Panel a shows the stored vConTACT3 *Duplodnaviria* dendrogram with all 17,260 tips,
its topology and branch lengths. Three rings annotate each tip: its sequence set, the
membership of its stored Infomap module and its genome size recorded by vConTACT3.
Consecutive tips with equal values are drawn as one ring segment. Panel b counts the
modules and sequences of the full 17,734-node network by module membership.
The outer VCX mark identifies archived module 44. Panel c shows the 274 predicted
vOTU–host-order associations for its 255 host-assigned vOTUs; Table S15 retains all
266 module members. Node size counts exact-match bird source groups across members.

```{r}

ring_segments <- function(df_rings, column) {
  df_rings |> dplyr::arrange(y) |>
    dplyr::mutate(value = .data[[column]],
      segment = cumsum(dplyr::row_number() == 1 | value != dplyr::lag(value))) |>
    dplyr::group_by(segment, value) |>
    dplyr::summarise(ymin = min(y) - 0.5, ymax = max(y) + 0.5, .groups = "drop")
}
ring_width <- tip_depth * 0.05
ring_start <- tip_depth * 1.025 + (0:2) * tip_depth * 0.062
ring_layer <- function(column, i) {

    ggplot2::aes(xmin = ring_start[i], xmax = ring_start[i] + ring_width, ymin = ymin,
      ymax = ymax, fill = value), inherit.aes = FALSE)
}

legend_only <- function(rings, corner) {
  p <- ggplot2::ggplot()
  for (i in seq_along(rings)) {
    if (i > 1) p <- p + ggnewscale::new_scale_fill()
    df_keys <- tibble::tibble(key = factor(names(rings[[i]]$values),
      levels = names(rings[[i]]$values)))
    p <- p + ggplot2::geom_tile(data = df_keys, ggplot2::aes(x = 0, y = 0, fill = key), alpha = 0) +
      ggplot2::scale_fill_manual(values = rings[[i]]$values, labels = rings[[i]]$labels,
        name = rings[[i]]$title, guide = ggplot2::guide_legend(order = i,
          override.aes = list(alpha = 1)))
  }
  p + ggplot2::theme_void(base_family = "Arial") +
    ggplot2::theme(legend.position = "inside", legend.position.inside = corner,
      legend.justification = corner, legend.box.just = "left",
      legend.title = ggplot2::element_text(size = 6.5, face = "bold"),
      legend.text = ggplot2::element_text(size = 6), legend.key.size = grid::unit(2.6, "mm"),
      legend.spacing.y = grid::unit(2.2, "mm"))
}

}
for (host in df_vcx_host_anchors$label) {
  single <- names(vcx_orders_per_votu)[vapply(vcx_orders_per_votu,
    function(x) length(x) == 1 && x == host, logical(1))]
  single <- sample(single, length(single))
  center <- df_vcx_host_anchors[df_vcx_host_anchors$label == host, ]
  if (length(single) == 0) next
  if (host %in% c("Oscillospirales", "Christensenellales", "Lachnospirales")) {
    radii <- if (host == "Oscillospirales") c(13, 19, 25, 31) else 16
    counts <- round(length(single) * radii / sum(radii))
    counts[length(counts)] <- length(single) - sum(head(counts, -1))
    xy <- lapply(seq_along(radii), function(i) {
      angles <- seq(0, 2 * pi, length.out = counts[i] + 1)[-1] + stats::runif(1, 0, 2 * pi)
      data.frame(x = center$x + radii[i] * cos(angles), y = center$y + radii[i] * sin(angles))
    }) |> dplyr::bind_rows()
  } else {
    xy <- data.frame(x = center$x + (seq_along(single) - (length(single) + 1) / 2) * 7,
      y = center$y - 7)
  }
  df_vcx_positions[match(single, df_vcx_positions$name), c("x", "y")] <- xy
}
stopifnot(!anyNA(df_vcx_positions$x), !anyNA(df_vcx_positions$y))
vcx_layout <- ggraph::create_layout(vcx_graph, layout = "manual",
  x = df_vcx_positions$x, y = df_vcx_positions$y)
df_vcx_host_positions <- as.data.frame(vcx_layout) |> dplyr::filter(node_type == "Host order") |>
  dplyr::mutate(ellipse_a = nchar(label) * 0.64 + 1.6, ellipse_b = 2.8)
p6c <- ggraph::ggraph(vcx_layout) +
  ggraph::geom_edge_link(colour = "#A6ACB2", linewidth = 0.22, alpha = 0.75) +
  ggraph::geom_node_point(ggplot2::aes(filter = node_type == "vOTU", size = node_size_groups),
    colour = "#2186B7", alpha = 0.95) +
  ggforce::geom_ellipse(data = df_vcx_host_positions,
    ggplot2::aes(x0 = x, y0 = y, a = ellipse_a, b = ellipse_b, angle = 0),
    inherit.aes = FALSE, fill = "#F2A3A5", colour = "#BA5158", linewidth = 0.3) +
  ggplot2::geom_text(data = df_vcx_host_positions, ggplot2::aes(x, y, label = label),
    inherit.aes = FALSE, family = "Arial", size = 2.2) +
  ggplot2::scale_size_continuous(name = "Bird source groups per vOTU", limits = c(1, 4),
    breaks = 1:4, range = c(1.25, 3.1)) +
  ggplot2::coord_fixed(xlim = c(-98, 98), ylim = c(-49, 49), clip = "off") +
  ggplot2::labs(title = "VCX: 255 vOTUs and 13 predicted host orders",
    caption = "Blue circles: vOTUs; red ellipses: host orders.\n28 vOTUs without matched source metadata use size 1.") +
  ggplot2::theme_void(base_family = "Arial", base_size = 7) +
  ggplot2::theme(plot.title = ggplot2::element_text(size = 8, face = "bold", hjust = 0.5),
    plot.caption = ggplot2::element_text(size = 6, hjust = 0),
    legend.position = "bottom", legend.direction = "horizontal",
    legend.title = ggplot2::element_text(size = 6.5), legend.text = ggplot2::element_text(size = 6),
    legend.key.width = grid::unit(7, "mm"),
    plot.margin = ggplot2::margin(4, 6, 3, 6))
figure6 <- patchwork::wrap_elements(full = p6a) / panel_tag(p6b, "b") / panel_tag(p6c, "c") +
  patchwork::plot_layout(heights = c(fan_height_mm, 36, 113))
save_pub_r(figure6, path_target("figure6-gene-content"), height_mm = fan_height_mm + 36 + 113)
readr::write_tsv(dplyr::bind_rows(
  as.data.frame(vcx_layout) |> dplyr::transmute(record_type = "node", node_id = name,
    node_type, label, x, y, source_group_count, node_size_groups),
  df_vcx_plot_edges |> dplyr::transmute(record_type = "edge", source = from, target = to,
    supporting_contigs)), path_target("figure6-vcx-network.tsv"))
readr::write_tsv(df_module_sequences |> dplyr::left_join(df_module_totals, by = "composition"),
  path_target("figure6-module-composition.tsv"))
```

## Supplementary Figure S1: overlap with fixed external catalogs

Panel a gives the share of representatives that match each fixed catalog, for all
representatives and for the near-complete subset; panel b resolves the overlaps among
the three matched sets. A match requires ANI ≥95% over ≥85% of the shorter sequence.

```{r}
#| label: figureS1-catalog-overlap
#| cache: false
path_comparison <- file.path(path_revision, "catalog-comparison")
df_overlap <- readr::read_tsv(file.path(path_comparison, "query-overlap-summary.tsv"),
  show_col_types = FALSE)
df_match_flags <- readr::read_tsv(file.path(path_comparison, "query-match-flags.tsv"),
  show_col_types = FALSE)
catalog_levels <- c("CVD", "CMKMC", "MGV", "Any compared catalog")
pal_query_set <- c("All representatives" = "#0072B2", "Near-complete" = "#009E73")
df_overlap_rates <- df_overlap |>
  dplyr::filter(query_stratum %in% c("All", "Completeness>90%; contamination<=5%"),
    reference_catalog %in% catalog_levels) |>
  dplyr::mutate(reference_catalog = factor(reference_catalog, levels = rev(catalog_levels)),
    query_set = factor(ifelse(query_stratum == "All", "All representatives", "Near-complete"),
      levels = names(pal_query_set)),
    label = sprintf("%s (%.1f%%)", scales::comma(matched_queries), matched_percent))
stopifnot(nrow(df_overlap_rates) == 8, nrow(df_match_flags) == 61608,
  sum(df_match_flags$matched_any) == 19938,
  identical(sort(unique(df_overlap_rates$query_denominator)), c(12939, 61608)))
df_catalog_bands <- tibble::tibble(reference_catalog = factor(catalog_levels[c(1, 3)],
  levels = rev(catalog_levels)))
pS1a <- ggplot2::ggplot(df_overlap_rates,
    ggplot2::aes(matched_percent, reference_catalog, fill = query_set)) +
  ggplot2::geom_tile(data = df_catalog_bands, ggplot2::aes(x = 50, y = reference_catalog),
    width = Inf, height = 1, fill = "#F2F2F2", inherit.aes = FALSE) +
  ggplot2::geom_col(position = ggplot2::position_dodge(width = 0.72, reverse = TRUE), width = 0.66) +
  ggplot2::geom_text(ggplot2::aes(label = label),
    position = ggplot2::position_dodge(width = 0.72, reverse = TRUE), hjust = -0.08, size = 2,
    family = "Arial") +
  ggplot2::scale_fill_manual(values = pal_query_set, name = NULL,
    labels = c("All representatives (n = 61,608)", "Near-complete (n = 12,939)")) +
  ggplot2::scale_x_continuous(limits = c(0, 100), breaks = seq(0, 100, 25),
    expand = ggplot2::expansion(c(0, 0))) +
  ggplot2::scale_y_discrete(limits = rev(catalog_levels),
    labels = c("Any compared catalog" = "Any of the three")) +
  ggplot2::labs(x = "Representatives with a match (%)", y = NULL) + theme_pub(6.5) +
  ggplot2::theme(legend.position = "top", legend.justification = "left",
    axis.ticks.y = ggplot2::element_blank(), axis.line.y = ggplot2::element_blank(),
    plot.margin = ggplot2::margin(4, 8, 4, 4))
df_catalog_sets <- df_match_flags |> dplyr::filter(matched_any) |>
  dplyr::transmute(vOTU_id, CVD = matched_CVD, CMKMC = matched_CMKMC, MGV = matched_MGV)
stopifnot(nrow(df_catalog_sets) == 19938,
  sum(df_catalog_sets$MGV & !df_catalog_sets$CVD & !df_catalog_sets$CMKMC) == 749)
pS1b <- upset_panel(as.data.frame(df_catalog_sets), c("CVD", "CMKMC", "MGV"),
  "Matched representatives", upright_counts = TRUE)
figureS1 <- (panel_tag(pS1a, "a") | panel_tag(pS1b, "b")) + patchwork::plot_layout(widths = c(1.15, 1))
save_pub_r(figureS1, path_target("figureS1-catalog-overlap"), height_mm = 78)
```

## Supplementary Figure S2: IMG/VR matches by reference sampling context

Panel a partitions each query set by its best available evidence: a match in CVD, CMKMC
or MGV, a match found only in IMG/VR v5, or no match. Panel b counts the representatives
that match references from each ecological source group; a representative can match
several groups. The darker inner bar marks the representatives absent from the
three-catalog union.

```{r}
#| label: figureS2-imgvr-context
#| cache: false
path_metavr <- file.path(path_revision, "catalog-comparison", "metavr")
df_metavr_ecosystem <- readr::read_tsv(file.path(path_metavr, "ecosystem-summary.tsv"),
  show_col_types = FALSE)
df_metavr_queries <- readr::read_tsv(file.path(path_metavr, "query-summary.tsv"),
  show_col_types = FALSE)
stopifnot(identical(df_metavr_queries$representatives, c(61608, 12939)),
  identical(df_metavr_queries$matched_four_catalogs, c(23515, 8526)), nrow(df_metavr_ecosystem) == 4)
pal_match_status <- c("CVD, CMKMC or MGV" = "#0072B2", "IMG/VR only" = "#E69F00",
  "No match" = "#D9D9D9")
df_union_status <- df_metavr_queries |>
  dplyr::transmute(query_set = factor(c("All representatives\n(n = 61,608)",
      "Near-complete\n(n = 12,939)"), levels = rev(c("All representatives\n(n = 61,608)",
      "Near-complete\n(n = 12,939)"))),
    `CVD, CMKMC or MGV` = matched_three_catalogs,
    `IMG/VR only` = matched_four_catalogs - matched_three_catalogs,
    `No match` = unmatched_four_catalogs) |>
  tidyr::pivot_longer(-query_set, names_to = "status", values_to = "representatives") |>
  dplyr::mutate(status = factor(status, levels = names(pal_match_status))) |>
  dplyr::group_by(query_set) |>
  dplyr::mutate(percent = 100 * representatives / sum(representatives),
    right = cumsum(percent), mid = right - percent / 2) |>
  dplyr::ungroup()
stopifnot(identical(df_union_status$representatives[df_union_status$status == "IMG/VR only"],
  c(3577, 525)))
df_union_inside <- df_union_status |> dplyr::filter(status != "IMG/VR only")
df_union_outside <- df_union_status |> dplyr::filter(status == "IMG/VR only")
pS2a <- ggplot2::ggplot(df_union_status, ggplot2::aes(percent, query_set, fill = status)) +
  ggplot2::geom_col(width = 0.5, position = ggplot2::position_stack(reverse = TRUE)) +
  ggplot2::geom_text(data = df_union_inside, ggplot2::aes(mid, query_set,
      label = sprintf("%s\n%.1f%%", scales::comma(representatives), percent)),
    inherit.aes = FALSE, size = 1.9, lineheight = 0.9, family = "Arial",
    colour = ifelse(df_union_inside$status == "No match", "black", "white")) +
  ggplot2::geom_segment(data = df_union_outside, ggplot2::aes(x = mid, xend = mid,
      y = as.numeric(query_set) + 0.27, yend = as.numeric(query_set) + 0.36),
    inherit.aes = FALSE, linewidth = 0.25) +
  ggplot2::geom_text(data = df_union_outside, ggplot2::aes(mid, as.numeric(query_set) + 0.38,
      label = sprintf("%s (%.1f%%)", scales::comma(representatives), percent)),
    inherit.aes = FALSE, vjust = 0, size = 1.9, family = "Arial") +
  ggplot2::scale_fill_manual(values = pal_match_status, name = NULL) +
  ggplot2::scale_x_continuous(breaks = seq(0, 100, 25), expand = ggplot2::expansion(c(0, 0.01))) +
  ggplot2::labs(x = "Representatives (%)", y = NULL) + theme_pub(6.5) +
  ggplot2::theme(legend.position = "top", legend.justification = "left",
    axis.ticks.y = ggplot2::element_blank(), axis.line.y = ggplot2::element_blank())
group_levels <- df_metavr_ecosystem |> dplyr::arrange(matched_queries) |>
  dplyr::pull(ecosystem_group)
df_context <- df_metavr_ecosystem |>
  dplyr::mutate(ecosystem_group = factor(ecosystem_group, levels = group_levels))
pS2b_bars <- ggplot2::ggplot(df_context, ggplot2::aes(y = ecosystem_group)) +
  ggplot2::geom_col(ggplot2::aes(x = matched_queries, fill = "All IMG/VR matches"), width = 0.66) +
  ggplot2::geom_col(ggplot2::aes(x = new_beyond_three_catalogs, fill = "Not in CVD, CMKMC or MGV"),
    width = 0.36) +
  ggplot2::geom_text(ggplot2::aes(x = matched_queries, label = scales::comma(matched_queries)),
    hjust = -0.15, size = 2, family = "Arial") +
  ggplot2::geom_text(ggplot2::aes(x = new_beyond_three_catalogs,
      label = scales::comma(new_beyond_three_catalogs)),
    hjust = 1.1, size = 1.8, family = "Arial", colour = "black") +
  ggplot2::scale_fill_manual(values = c("All IMG/VR matches" = "#F5D9A8",
    "Not in CVD, CMKMC or MGV" = "#E69F00"), name = NULL) +
  ggplot2::scale_x_continuous(labels = scales::comma, breaks = seq(0, 8000, 2000),
    expand = ggplot2::expansion(c(0, 0.14))) +
  ggplot2::labs(x = "AvianViromeDB representatives", y = NULL) + theme_pub(6.5) +
  ggplot2::theme(legend.position = "bottom", legend.justification = "left",
    axis.ticks.y = ggplot2::element_blank(), axis.line.y = ggplot2::element_blank())
pS2b_references <- ggplot2::ggplot(df_context,
    ggplot2::aes(x = 1, y = ecosystem_group, label = scales::comma(references))) +
  ggplot2::geom_text(hjust = 1, size = 2, family = "Arial", colour = "#333333") +
  ggplot2::scale_x_continuous(limits = c(0, 1), expand = ggplot2::expansion(c(0, 0))) +
  ggplot2::labs(title = "Matched reference\nsequences") + ggplot2::theme_void(base_family = "Arial") +
  ggplot2::theme(plot.title = ggplot2::element_text(size = 6.2, face = "bold", hjust = 1,
    lineheight = 0.9))
pS2b <- (pS2b_bars | pS2b_references) + patchwork::plot_layout(widths = c(4, 0.9))
figureS2 <- (panel_tag(pS2a, "a") | panel_tag(pS2b, "b")) + patchwork::plot_layout(widths = c(1, 1.15))
save_pub_r(figureS2, path_target("figureS2-imgvr-context"), height_mm = 62)
```
